'''2016 European Championship Day 2 Eric Spijksma LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Erik Spijksma]] at [[2016 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Erik Spijksma]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open QMC Spijksma LS 2016 EC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125837/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-european-championships.html Internet Archive]
